title: TuCo: Measuring the Contribution of Fine-Tuning to Individual Responses of LLMs
summary: Released core metric divides by initial-state+PTC+FTC norms, whereas published definition uses PTC+FTC. Traced storage and default analysis retain discrepancy; exact toy ranks reverse. Historical tables remain Needs Evidence. The already-demonstrated Proposition4.2 endpoint defect is explicitly assessed Minor; the inclusive-prefix bound is verified.
limitations: No author-code execution, LLM inference, attacks, or benchmark reproduction.
Exact historical code/results provenance unresolved; no claim published AUC values are false.
Not all plotting notebooks, model callbacks, or statistical tests inspected.
README arXiv link observed but no version comparison or global erratum search.

problems.source_claim: Proposition4.2 controls the final hidden-state discrepancy by beta=max over 0<=l<L of cumulative FTC/(PTC+FTC).

assumptions: One layer L1, scalar common initial state0

problems.check: At L1 the printed maximum only includes empty sums, hence beta0 and bound0, whereas the final discrepancy is1. Inclusive beta_*=1/2 gives bound1. Telescoping and discrete Gronwall prove d_l<=A(1+B)^l with A<=ML*beta_*/(1-beta_*).
problems.result: Printed endpoint is false; the inclusive-prefix statement used in the appendix is verified.
problems.counterevidence: Appendixp22 expressly controls the inclusive prefix. Section4.5 separately defines terminal projected TuCo and does not claim that it inherits the full-prefix output-distance guarantee.
problems.core_dependency: Local statement endpoint; the inclusive derivation and separately defined TuCo metric survive. No additional material core-metric damage is demonstrated beyond P1.
problems.impact: Minor based on limited dependency, not appendix location or ease of repair.

correction.statement: Take beta_*=max_{0<=l<=L} ||FTC_l||_1/(||PTC_l||_1+||FTC_l||_1), assigning empty 0/0 to0, and assume beta_*<1; then d_L<=ML(1+B)^L*beta_*/(1-beta_*).
correction.limits: At beta_*=1 no finite bound follows. This does not create a theorem relating terminal projected TuCo alone to final output discrepancy.

clarifications.details: Displayed simplification signs differ, but printed looser bound remains valid; sharper expression derived.
Paper explicitly changes metric to terminal projected ratio; not treated as an inherited output-distance theorem.
